column1: # Divergences for ICO and CUR files; see README.md.

column4: ICO: RECOIL has no ICO/CUR support. Layout per the Microsoft icon format (ICONDIR, DIB image with AND mask). Largest DIB image; matches Pillow's decode of the same image pixel for pixel on RGB (alpha is the 32-bit channel or the AND mask: equal to Pillow's RGBA where Pillow applies the mask, which it does not for 1-bit and palette images, and to a separate parse of the DIB; rgb() is black where alpha is 0)
